I can see the home page of the PetClinic application. I need to navigate to the veterinarians overview page. I can see there's a "Veterinarians" link in the navigation bar that points to `/vets.html`.

Let me click on that link to navigate to the veterinarians overview page.

from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright

with sync_playwright() as playwright:
    browser = playwright.chromium.connect_over_cdp("http://localhost:9222/")

    page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")

```
